options.content:
#### LED colour by CPU temperature
| Temp (°C) | LED colour |
|---|---|
| < 45 | 🟢 **green** (cool) |
| 45 – 52 | 🔵 **blue** |
| 52 – 57 | 🟡 **yellow** |
| 57 – 62 | 🟠 **orange** |
| 62 – 65 | 🔴 **red** |
| > 65 | 🟣 **purple — blinking ALARM** |

Brightness rises with temperature.
